headline: Human Neuronal UNC13A Cryptic-Exon Blockade Restores Evoked Synaptic Release
prior_state_or_assumption: Preclinical UNC13A (EALS-001) steric-ASO validation rested on iPSC motor-neuron splicing and Munc13-1 protein recovery (Brown 2022 PMID:35197628; Ma 2022 PMID:35197626) without defining the quantitative human protein threshold required to rescue evoked synaptic transmission.
new_evidence_or_revision: Keuss et al. (2026, Nature, PMID:43015463, DOI:10.1038/s41586-026-11256-2) demonstrated that restoring >30% human UNC13A protein via Intron-20 cryptic-exon deletion (~75% protein rescue) or 2'-O-MOE ASOs rescues miniature and evoked AMPA EPSCs and MEA network synchrony across human cortical and spinal motor neurons. Postsynaptic mEPSC amplitude reduction remained unrescued, and single-target UNC13A rescue leaves orthogonal STMN2 polyadenylation and KCNQ2 Exon-5 skipping unaddressed.
portfolio_and_gate_consequence: Reinforces EALS-001 (#3/52, Keep · Core, Bio #1) causal validity while retaining Tier 2 positioning behind sponsor-owned ICH M3(R2) single-entity GLP intrathecal tox on clean window #2 chr19:17642537-17642554(-) and Stage 2 rs12973192/rs12608932 genotype-stratified 2-plex vs 3-plex testing.

prior_state_or_assumption: Combination models of STMN2 rescue plus SARM1 inhibition often assume indirect NMNAT2 epistasis and interpret bulk plasma cADPR drops as direct axonal SARM1 target engagement without bounding rare ARM-GoF residual NADase activity or ecto-CD38 fluid background.
new_evidence_or_revision: Evaluated clinical allosteric SIR2501 (NCT07765446 CIPN Ph2) and reversible orthosteric NB-4746 (NCT07369076) across three modeled bounds: (1) 1.0x parallel Bliss survival additivity (Krus 2022 PMID:35767949; Matson & Holzbaur 2026 DOI:10.64898/2026.11.07.764673) to ~2–7x (med ~3x) NMNAT2-transport-coupled MWC dose-sparing (Beccari 2025 PMID:40392845); (2) ~30–40% residual NADase ceiling at 100x Kd in rare ARM-broken GoF heterozygotes (Gilley 2021 PMID:34796871; Bloom 2022 PMID:34991663); (3) modeled ~5–10% selective cell-free fluid cADPR drop under >90–95% ecto-CD38 fluid background vs ~45–50% implied CD38 inhibition if cell-free plasma cADPR drops -50% (cf. tissue cADPR PMID:32087251; PDB 9TZY BEXi adduct 17 PMID:42156967).
portfolio_and_gate_consequence: Retains EALS-030 (#1/52, Keep · Core) while requiring Cys311Ala non-covalency verification, <1% SARM1 GoF carrier sequencing exclusion, enzymatic CD38 counter-screening, and unbound CSF trough PK.

In modeled pulsed q48h–q72h turnover simulations (>=55% substrate clearance and end-of-cycle stress <=0.05), removing the occupancy dead-zone cuts grid survival from ~79% (64/81) to ~30% (24/81) at matched 10–20 h repair and 0% (0/81) at slower 24–48 h postmitotic CASM washout.
portfolio_and_gate_consequence: Retains EALS-020 (#23/52, Keep · Exploratory) (continuous BID failed clinically in NCT05163886 / NCT06215755; pulsed q48h–q72h remains clinically untested) behind a 14-day human iPSC-MN CASM washout and intracellular + secreted DPR mass-balance validation gate.
